what: trust-gate calibration (amendment 1, A6), real twin and real Track 2 predictor
scales_rule: std of the training-split delta labels in t2/data/t2_dataset_v0.npz

notes.rule: after n >= warmup scored changes, pause when recent_needed of the last recent_window changes have e > tau, or the bias-corrected EWMA trust (alpha) of the per-change score falls below pause_below (amendment 1, A6)
notes.scales: std of the counterfactual KPI delta in the stand-in predictor's fit set (Maveric official preset, seeds 10000+, 300 random changes: 0.062, 0.036, 0.63 dB), so e = 1 means an error the size of a typical effect
notes.direction_deadband: materiality: a measured delta smaller than 2 % of UEs or 0.4 dB of p10 SINR is 'did not move' and not scored for direction
notes.alpha_tau_pause_below: chosen by t3.trust.calibrate's PROPOSAL_RULE on 288 replayed changes x 2 predictors (12 episodes x 24 changes, seeds 20000-20011): at most 1 of 12 healthy episodes paused, then most degraded episodes paused within 6 changes; in-sample, so the held-out check is the demo seeds
notes.max_changes_to_pause: declared target for the degraded-predictor demo
notes.recalibrate: rerun t3.trust.calibrate with W9's real Track 2 predictor before the scored run; these values fit the stand-in linear predictor

proposal_rule: joint grid over alpha in {0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.3} and pause_below in {0.05, 0.10, ..., 0.70}; for each pair take the smallest tau in {0.50, 0.55, ..., 5.00} at which the full rule pauses the healthy model in at most `calibration_false_pause_budget` (declared) calibration episodes. Among those, pick the most degraded episodes paused within max_changes_to_pause, then the smallest mean changes-to-pause (not paused counts as length + 1), then the fewest healthy pauses, then the largest healthy margin (lowest healthy post-warm-up trust minus pause_below)

notes.rule: after n >= warmup scored changes, pause when recent_needed of the last recent_window changes have e > tau, or the bias-corrected EWMA trust (alpha) of the per-change score falls below pause_below (amendment 1, A6)

notes.direction_deadband: materiality: a measured delta smaller than 2 % of UEs or 0.4 dB of p10 SINR is 'did not move' and not scored for direction
notes.alpha_tau_pause_below: written by t3.trust.calibrate --apply (PROPOSAL_RULE) from replayed changes on twin.replay (official, nominal, seeds 20000+) with t2.predict healthy and tilt_reversed; in-sample, so the held-out check is the demo seeds; see t3/trust/calibration.json
